fields.title: Job search / detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of topcv.vn's own data. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Full-detail records (search mode with fetchFullDetails=true, or detail mode) carry the site's own public schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD object verbatim (title, description, baseSalary, jobLocation, hiringOrganization, ...). Search-mode records with fetchFullDetails=false carry only the compact search-result-card fields this actor parses out of the SSR search results HTML (job_id, title, url, company_name, salary_text, city, tags, posted_text, ...). Content is Vietnamese and passed through untranslated.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword/city search or job ID/URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-jsonld (full-detail record, from the job page's own JobPosting JSON-LD), S1-html-search (compact search-summary record, from the SSR search results HTML), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, invalid_input, invalid_city).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Present only when a search result's detail fetch failed and this record fell back to the compact search-summary fields instead (detail_fetch_failed_used_search_summary).

job_id.title: Job ID
job_id.description: Search-summary record -- topcv.vn's numeric job ID.

salary_text.title: Salary (as displayed)
salary_text.description: Search-summary record -- e.g. "Tới 45 triệu" or "Thoả thuận" (negotiable), as shown on the site, not parsed into a number.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Search-summary record -- job-function/skill/benefit tag list shown on the result card.

posted_updated_text.title: Updated (relative, as displayed)
posted_updated_text.description: Search-summary record -- e.g. "Cập nhật 3 phút trước".

is_verified_employer.title: Verified employer
is_verified_employer.description: Search-summary record -- whether topcv.vn shows its verified-employer badge.

description.title: Full description
description.description: Full-detail record -- HTML-formatted job description, requirements, and benefits combined (topcv.vn's own JobPosting.description).

identifier.title: Employer identifier
identifier.description: Full-detail record -- {name, value} where value is the employer's numeric company ID.

hiringOrganization.title: Hiring organization
hiringOrganization.description: Full-detail record -- {name, sameAs (company page URL), logo}.

jobLocation.title: Job location
jobLocation.description: Full-detail record -- {address: {streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry}}.

baseSalary.title: Base salary
baseSalary.description: Full-detail record -- {currency, value: {unitText, minValue?, maxValue?}}. When the employer marks salary negotiable, `value.value` holds the literal Vietnamese string "Thoả thuận" instead of a numeric minValue/maxValue -- confirmed live, not a parsing gap.

jobBenefits.title: Job benefits
jobBenefits.description: Full-detail record -- HTML-formatted, also included inline within `description`.

employerOverview.title: Employer overview / responsibilities
employerOverview.description: Full-detail record -- HTML-formatted, also included inline within `description`.

totalJobOpenings.title: Total job openings
totalJobOpenings.description: Full-detail record -- number of open headcount for this posting.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-summary and full-detail records.
